name: Cavalier Faerie Knight
body:
Sworn to capricious fey courts and the verdant powers of the Otherworld, the faerie knight commands woodland beasts and channels unpredictable fey glamours.

The secretive lords and ladies of Faerie occasionally embroil mortals in their endless intrigues. Faerie knights possess a measure of respect not often offered to mortals, but they walk a razor’s edge in serving the unknowable fey.

Fey Mount (Ex)

A faerie knight’s mount must be a creature native to woodland realms (such as an elk, stag, boar, or wolf). The mount gains low-light vision and a +2 bonus on saves against enchantment spells and effects. Replaces the standard cavalier mount list.

Court Edicts (Ex)

The faerie knight must obey the courtesies of the fey: never break a sworn oath, never refuse hospitality to a woodland traveler, and always punish those who desecrate sacred groves.

Fey Glamour (Sp)

At 3rd level, the faerie knight can cast disguise self and vanish once per day as spell-like abilities. Replaces the 3rd-level cavalier bonus feat.
